name: public-blind-relay R-5: same-NAT peers connect through the default relay (relaydrill netns harness, defaults arm)
summary: Two peers in separate network namespaces behind the tower's one public IP (no hairpin), joined to one hyperswarm topic through the shipped sync-relay module (resolveSyncRelayKeys(syncRelayKeyReader(undefined))). Both arms unset PAPERCUSP_VOICE_RELAY_KEYS. Control arm PAPERCUSP_RELAY_DEFAULTS=0: no relay key, never connects. Defaults arm PAPERCUSP_RELAY_DEFAULTS=1: the shipped default key b1015b56 is used and both peers record a relayed connection. Plan public-blind-relay-2026-10-01 clause AUTO-BAR-R-5-P-004. Log: .papercusp/scratch/relaydrill/run-defaults-r2.log.
